SELECT observed_at AS time, entity_id AS game, value AS players
FROM observations FINAL
WHERE source = 'steam' AND entity_type = 'game' AND metric = 'players_current'
  AND entity_id IN (${game:singlequote})
  AND observed_at >= $__fromTime AND observed_at <= $__toTime
ORDER BY time, game

FROM observations FINAL
WHERE source = 'steam' AND entity_type = 'game' AND metric = 'chart_rank'
  AND entity_id IN (${game:singlequote})
  AND observed_at >= $__fromTime AND observed_at <= $__toTime
ORDER BY time, game

defaults.noValue: No baseline yet: needs chart data from at least ${period} day(s) before the latest chart

targets.rawSql:
WITH chart AS (SELECT entity_id AS game, toDate(observed_at, 'UTC') AS d, toInt32(value) AS r
  FROM observations FINAL
  WHERE source = 'steam' AND entity_type = 'game' AND metric = 'chart_rank'),
  (SELECT maxOrNull(d) FROM chart) AS cur,
  (SELECT maxOrNull(d) FROM chart WHERE d <= cur - ${period}) AS prev
SELECT game, rank_now, rank_then, delta, status, day_now, day_then
FROM (
  SELECT
    game,
    minIf(toNullable(r), d = cur) AS rank_now,
    minIf(toNullable(r), d = prev) AS rank_then,
    toInt32(rank_then - rank_now) AS delta,
    multiIf(rank_then IS NULL, 'new', rank_now IS NULL, 'dropped', delta > 0, 'up', delta < 0, 'down', 'same') AS status,
    assumeNotNull(cur) AS day_now,
    assumeNotNull(prev) AS day_then
  FROM chart
  WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND d IN (cur, prev)
  GROUP BY game
)
ORDER BY
  indexOf(['new', 'up', 'down', 'dropped', 'same'], status),
  abs(coalesce(delta, 0)) DESC,
  coalesce(rank_now, rank_then) ASC,
  game ASC

list.query:
SELECT game
FROM (SELECT entity_id AS game, toDate(observed_at, 'UTC') AS d, toInt32(value) AS r
  FROM observations FINAL
  WHERE source = 'steam' AND entity_type = 'game' AND metric = 'chart_rank')
GROUP BY game
ORDER BY max(d) DESC, argMax(r, d) ASC, game ASC
